title: Visual Large Models Receive a Major Open-Source Announcement! Multimodal Generation Upgraded, How Will 2K HD Audio and Video Revolutionize the Industry?

content_html:
On August 3, the AI company MiniMax officially announced the open source release of its next-generation general video model MiniMax H3. As a full-modal generation system, this model breaks through the traditional single-task boundaries, and can deeply integrate and understand multimodal contexts composed of text, images, videos, and audio, demonstrating strong task generalization capabilities.

In terms of generation specifications, H3 supports output durations from 4 to 15 seconds, with a frame rate of 24 FPS and 32 kHz stereo sound. Users can choose from various common aspect ratios such as 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, and 1:1, and can also perform basic creation by default setting the shorter side to 768 pixels. With the dedicated H3-Regenerate-2K solution, the model can even output stunning images at up to 2K resolution. In terms of multilingual interaction, it can stably support 11 major languages, including Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian.

To adapt to diverse creative scenarios, H3 introduces flexible model versions and rich input specifications. The H3-Base-FL2VA first-last frame mode supports inputting 0 to 2 images, and can freely and flexibly handle different tasks such as text-to-video, first-frame-to-video, last-frame-to-video, and first-last frame collaboration. The H3-Base-Ref2VA full-modal reference mode, on the other hand, supports mixed input of up to 9 images, 3 video clips (total duration not exceeding 15 seconds), and 3 audio segments, with a maximum of 12 files in total, providing professional creators with unprecedented fine control.

In the underlying system architecture, the complete MiniMax H3 includes three core modules. First is the H3-Context-IR (context intermediate representation), which can deeply analyze complex multi-instructions and convert them into structures that are easy for the model to understand, serving as a key link to ensure high-quality output. Then comes the H3-Base module, responsible for generating base audio and video at 768p resolution. Finally, there is the H3-Regenerate-2K module, which achieves 2K super-resolution reconstruction by feeding back the initial results and original context. This combination preserves vivid details while significantly improving visual fidelity.

Currently, the model has been officially released under the MiniMax H3 Community License. Developers and tech enthusiasts can obtain the complete open-source code and resources through Hugging Face. Industry experts generally believe that this open-source release will further reduce the application barriers of multimodal video generation, driving film production, visual design, and AI interaction to new heights.

content_html_zh:
8月3日，AI公司MiniMax正式宣布开源发布其下一代通用视频模型MiniMax H3。 作为一个全模态生成系统，该模型突破了传统的单任务边界，能够深度集成和理解由文本、图像、视频和音频组成的多模态上下文，展现出强大的任务泛化能力。

在生成规格方面，H3支持输出时长为4至15秒，帧率为24 FPS和32 kHz立体声。 用户可以选择21:9、16:9、4:3、1:1等多种常见的宽高比，也可以通过默认将短边设置为768像素来进行基本创建。 借助专用的 H3-Regenerate-2K 解决方案，该模型甚至可以输出高达 2K 分辨率的令人惊叹的图像。 多语言交互方面，可稳定支持阿拉伯语、中文、英语、法语、德语、意大利语、日语、韩语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、俄语等11种主要语言。

为了适应多样化的创作场景，H3引入了灵活的模型版本和丰富的输入规格。 H3-Base-FL2VA首末帧模式支持输入0到2张图像，可以自由灵活地处理文本转视频、首帧转视频、末帧转视频、首末帧协作等不同任务。 H3-Base-Ref2VA全模态参考模式则支持最多9张图片、3个视频片段（总时长不超过15秒）和3个音频片段的混合输入，总共最多12个文件，为专业创作者提供前所未有的精细控制。

在底层系统架构上，完整的MiniMax H3包括三大核心模块。 首先是H3-Context-IR（上下文中间表示），它可以深入分析复杂的多指令，并将其转换为易于模型理解的结构，作为保证高质量输出的关键环节。 然后是 H3-Base 模块，负责生成 768p 分辨率的基本音频和视频。 最后是H3-Regenerate-2K模块，通过反馈初始结果和原始上下文来实现2K超分辨率重建。 这种组合保留了生动的细节，同时显着提高了视觉保真度。

目前，该模型已在MiniMax H3社区许可证下正式发布。 开发者和科技爱好者可以通过Hugging Face获取完整的开源代码和资源。 业内专家普遍认为，本次开源发布将进一步降低多模态视频生成的应用门槛，推动电影制作、视觉设计、AI交互迈向新高度。
